title: use let-else in relay_queue drain_once stem extraction
description: relay_queue.rs line 366-369 uses 'let stem = match env_path.file_stem()... { Some(s) => s.to_string(), None => continue }' — the let-else form (stabilized Rust 1.65) is more idiomatic: 'let Some(stem) = env_path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) else { continue }'. Eliminates the manual to_string and the match arm with continue.
